retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style studio portrait of a soldier in formal dress uniform against a dark, textured green background with heavy, blocky sans-serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-quarter profile studio portrait of a man in a dark green military uniform and beret, positioned against a deep forest-green gradient background. The composition features heavy, condensed sans-serif typography at the top, balanced by a vertical list of secondary text on the left, capturing the formal and somber tone of 1960s patriotic media.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed off-camera to the left
High-contrast lighting emphasizing facial texture and uniform details
Typography integrated into the negative space of the background
Color harmony between the uniform and the backdrop
coreInvariants: Formal military dress uniform with beret

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, facing left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright insignia on the beret.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large header text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the gaze to the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark green negative space on the left side, utilized for secondary text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and gold (uniform medals and patches)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the skin tones and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or purples
Maintain a muted, earthy tonal range

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold nature of the display text.
Provides the correct mid-century sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a 1960s-era dark green military dress uniform and beret, facing three-quarters left against a dark textured green background. Leave the top and left side clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase condensed bold sans-serif text in pale yellow across the top. Add a vertical list of smaller title-case text in the same color on the left side.

verificationChecks: Is the background a dark, textured green?
Is the subject in a formal military uniform with a beret?
Is the primary text a heavy, condensed sans-serif?
Is the text color a pale yellow or cream?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the color balance between the uniform and background
recipe.reuseFormula: Military Portrait + 1960s Record Cover Layout + Condensed Sans-Serif + Forest Green Palette
